column2: description

Take a photo of something in the neighbourhood, and post it on social media.
The photo must get at least 10 likes (or equivalent) within 10 minutes.
You may not like the photo, request likes, or tell anyone you need likes to win.
You may attempt this challenge only once per neighbourhood.

column1: Know someone who lives around here
column2:
Visit a house or building where someone you personally know currently lives, or used to live. 
Tell your team about it.
column3: A picture of the building and the name of the person

column2: Find an actual real life cat.

column1: Write an ode to another team
column2:
Send a complementary poem to another team.
The poem must be positive about the other team.
The poem must include a rhyme for each of the other team’s names.
The poem must be at least 8 lines long.

Go somewhere that somebody died and give a short eulogy.
The place must be a building, or area less than 100 x 100 meters.
The person must have died at least 100 years ago.
You must know the name or specific biographical information about the person who died
You must.be able to verify the person died there.

Film a bird for 3 minutes.
The bird must be distinct and visible in frame for the entire video.
The video must be continuous e.g. no pausing.

The event must have at least 10 people in attendance.
The event must have some kind of public advertisement (facebook event, web page, poster).
You must attend for at least 10 minutes.
column3: Photo of you at the event, and public advertisement of the event

column1: Give your teammate a genuine compliment
column2:
Choose one team member. 
Each other team member must give them a genuine compliment.
Each compliment must be unique.

Make three promises about how you will improve this neighbourhood.
You must make a promise outside of a school, library, church or park. 
You may not use the same type of location more than once.

Play a real musical instrument.
The instrument cannot be improvised, or something you brought with you.
The instrument must be something created for the purpose of making music

Sit on grass for ten minutes.
The grass must be alive and in the ground.
column3: Picture of your team on grass

column2:
Have fun for 15 minutes.
You must be doing a fun activity for the entire 15 minutes.
Your fun activity must involve something in the neighbourhood.
You must stay in the same place while having fun.
column3: Picture of your team having fun

column2:
Find something that a team member has a tattoo of.
If nobody on your team has a tattoo, go to a tattoo parlour, and find something from the front window.
The thing must be physical, and the main subject of the tattoo.
The thing you find must be as specific as the tattoo. For example, a tattoo of a fireman cannot be a tattoo of a "person"
column3: Picture of the tattoo and the thing you found

column2:
Choose a thing and visit that thing.
When you arrive at that thing, search for it on Youtube. If there is a video about the thing with at least 1000 views, you succeed. If not, you may try again with another thing.
You must search for the specific thing you are visiting, not a category.
The video must mention or directly reference your thing in the title.

Photograph a team member from at least 500 metres away. 
The other team member must be visible in the photo. They do not need to be recognisable.

Visit every McDonalds in this neighbourhood.
There must be at least one McDonalds.
You must go inside each McDonalds.

Transport water from one fountain to another.
The fountain must not be intended for drinking. 
The fountain must be decorative and have flowing water.
column3: Photo or video of water being taken, and given

column2:
Create a haiku out of signs. 
The sign must be the name of a business, a street or landmark, or a public building.
Each line of the haiku must be the entirety of a single sign.
The haiku must follow a 5-7-5 syllable format.

Find a real mushroom.
The mushroom must be naturally occurring, unharvested and obviously alive.

Recreate a statue with your body.
You must be next to the statue you are recreating.
The statue must include a depiction of a living creature.
column3: Photo of the statue and your recreation
